result.keywords: This fictional study examines color calibration in portable tide-monitoring lanterns used for coastal ecology demonstrations. It describes a low-cost optical enclosure, slow-refresh sensor fusion, and field notes from intertidal stations where illumination must remain constant despite spray, fog, and changing ambient light. The work emphasizes hardware ergonomics and educational deployment rather than robotics, language processing, or microfluidics.
result.title: Lagoon Shift at Dusk.
